definitions.explanation: Money paid to workers for their labor.

examples.japanese: {賃金|ちんぎん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧。
⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧{賃金|ちんぎん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げられた→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。
{賃金|ちんぎん}⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Wage disparities have become an issue.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧{賃金|ちんぎん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}く→低い：02947_hikui⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In this area, the minimum wage is low, and many people struggle to make a living.

notes:
{賃金|ちんぎん} is a formal term for wages paid in exchange for labor, commonly used in economic, legal, and labor contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧{賃金|ちんぎん}: minimum wage
- {賃金|ちんぎん}⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: wage negotiations
- {賃金|ちんぎん}⟦{水準|すいじゅん}→水準：03357_suijun⟧: wage level
- {賃金|ちんぎん}⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧: wage disparity
- {賃金|ちんぎん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧: to raise wages

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧: salary (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧: salary/pay (formal, often for salaried employees)
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧: compensation, remuneration (broader, can include non-wage pay)

REGISTER:
{賃金|ちんぎん} is used in formal contexts such as news reports, labor law, and economics. In casual conversation, ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧ is more natural.
